caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, monochromatic illustration of a metal object with an ornate handle and a heart-shaped body. The handle resembles a stylized leaf with curled ends, transitioning into a circular and triangular framework inside the heart-shaped main section. Within the triangle at the center are the words "LOVE," "PURITY," and "FIDELITY," one on each side, encircling a central raised star motif. The object is shown from an angled perspective in the lower right, revealing three short legs on the underside, and from a top-down and side view in the upper left, along with a small scale for measurement. The drawing utilizes shades of gray and black to render the object with dimensional shading, all outlined with fine, consistent lines. The artist’s signature, "S. Borrazzo," appears at the bottom left of the page.
title: Flat Iron Holder
